anchor.exact: Ponjo: Reimagine the Human-Agent Co-Writing Experience with Nebius x Nvidia Nemotron

body: @Nebius What do I need to cover in this demo?

@fanzhangg In the demo, you should cover the problem of turn‑taking AI writing, introduce Ponjo as a real‑time human‑AI co‑editing system, show the live editor with simultaneous edits/comments, demonstrate the agent runtime and its three principles (agent as human user, stateless runs, read‑and‑propose), and highlight the key features from the product vision (local plain‑text files, comment‑based UI, multiple AI buddies, teammate joining via link). Keep it concise and end with the before/after image to illustrate the improvement.
I have 3 mins to the demo: How do I plan my time?

For a 3‑minute demo, allocate roughly: 30 s problem statement, 45 s intro to Ponjo & live editor demo, 45 s agent runtime & three principles, 45 s key product‑vision features, and 30 s before/after wrap‑up. Practice with a timer to keep each section tight.
@Ponjo What are the three key features of this app according to the product vision doc?

The product vision highlights three key features: (1) real‑time co‑editing of a plain‑text file with AI buddies as teammates, (2) AI buddies act through comments—no separate chat—and (3) the system works locally, using any CLI agent, keeping files on your machine.
Can you apply those features as the bullet points under the features section?
Applied the three key features as bullet points under the Features section.
